project_type: Kotlin Android app with Jetpack Compose, Supabase backend
test_framework: JUnit4 + Compose UI test (minimal tests present)
test_command: N/A - no meaningful test suite to run
verification_instructions: 1. Run ./gradlew assembleDebug. 2. Verify build succeeds with no compilation errors.
setup_instructions: JDK 17 required. Create google-services.json in app/ for Firebase. Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env vars or in local.properties.
environment_constraints: External downloads blocked. Cannot install new packages. Must work with existing dependencies in build.gradle.kts. No emulator available for runtime testing - validation is compile-only.
contribution_requirements: Build must pass. Push to origin Rexo-Kotlin branch.
key_patterns: Uses RexoColors object for colors, RexoTheme.typography for text styles, GlassSurface component for cards. ViewModels use StateFlow. Repositories use Supabase Postgrest client with DTOs. NavGraph in navigation/NavGraph.kt has MainScaffold with ModernBottomNavigation. Screens use Scaffold with TopAppBar.
directory_structure: app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ contains: data/ (model, repository, remote, local), navigation/, ui/ (screens, viewmodel, theme, components), services/, utils/. Root has supabase/ with schema.sql and migrations.
